links.outcome: LLM refusal behavior on unanswerable drug-label questions in document-grounded QA benchmark
links.effect: Experiments across proprietary and open-weight models revealed substantial gaps in safe refusal behavior, alongside gaps in factual grounding and long-context retrieval. No numbers in the abstract.
links.quote: Experiments across proprietary and open-weight models reveal substantial gaps in factual grounding, long-context retrieval, and safe refusal behavior.

screen.reason: Introduces and evaluates LLMs on FDARxBench, an expert-curated benchmark assessing factual grounding, retrieval, and refusal behavior on FDA generic drug assessment labels.
